source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the functioning of the kidney (PDF 16-17).

blocks.text: Gurde khoon se metabolic fuzlaat aur zaid pani chhaan kar peshab (urine) ki shakal mein bahar nikalte hain. Peshab banne ke amal ke teen bare qadam hain jo nephron mein hote hain: glomerular filtration (chhanna), selective reabsorption (chun kar wapas lena) aur tubular secretion (tubule mein dalna).

blocks.title: Gurde: excretion bhi, osmoregulation bhi
blocks.text: Fuzlaat nikalne (excretion) ke saath saath gurde osmoregulation ka kaam bhi karte hain. Jab jism ki rutoobatein hypotonic (zyada patli) hon to gurde patla peshab banate hain, aur jab rutoobatein hypertonic (zyada gaarhi) hon aur jism mein pani ki kami (dehydration) ho to gaarha peshab banate hain. Is tarah gurde jism ki rutoobaton mein namak ki miqdar qaboo karte hain.
